reason: I'd join with the café's link and use the free collab, sure, but I'm not paying ₹499 until I can see there are real businesses on it and not just the one café that sent me. Every collab app I've tried was empty after week one.
objection: Is it actually full of Bengaluru businesses that want a 5K-follower creator, or is it empty like the others? And with the pass I have to make promo videos for 'participating businesses', which sounds like unpaid work on top of paying them.
would_change_my_mind: If the free collab actually got me a good collab and I could see a bunch of other local businesses on there wanting creators my size, I'd pay for the pass.
